content.short: Unstoppable Domains provides blockchain-based domain names for simplifying asset transfers.
content.description: Unstoppable Domains creates blockchain-based domain names that replace long wallet addresses with human-readable identifiers. With a single purchase, you obtain a one-time domain that enables hosting decentralized websites, accepting crypto payments, and governing your digital identity across supported networks. By linking your domain to compatible wallets, apps, and services, you gain a portable, censorship-resistant presence on the decentralized web and a simpler, more intuitive way to interact with blockchain-enabled experiences.
